pipeline.modality: Selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM, oral small molecule)

indications.indication: Sarcopenic obesity / muscle preservation in patients on GLP-1 RA for chronic weight management
indications.trial_name: Phase 2 proof-of-concept (enobosarm + semaglutide); preceded by completed Phase 2b QUALITY dose-finding
indications.trial_design: Phase 2 randomized study assessing total body weight, physical function, and safety of enobosarm in patients on GLP-1 RA for weight loss; QUALITY Phase 2b previously met primary endpoint (100% relative reduction in lean-mass loss vs placebo + semaglutide, p<0.001) in Jan 2025; Phase 2b PLATEAU 72-week study planned to begin Q1 CY2026
key_milestones: QUALITY Phase 2b primary endpoint met Jan 2025
Modified-release oral formulation on track for Phase 3
PLATEAU Phase 2b planned start Q1 CY2026

pipeline.modality: Oral small-molecule microtubule disruptor (binds colchicine site on beta-tubulin)
pipeline.target: Beta-tubulin (colchicine binding site); broad anti-inflammatory (suppresses IL-1, IL-6, IL-8, TNF-alpha, IFN-gamma, CXCL10)

indications.indication: Inflammation in atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (stable CAD; hsCRP reduction)
indications.trial_design: Small Phase 2 dose-finding study assessing whether sabizabulin reduces high-sensitivity C-reactive protein in patients with stable CAD
indications.trial_status: PLANNED — pre-IND meeting held with FDA Division of Cardiology and Nephrology Dec 26, 2024; FDA agreed unmet medical need exists; sufficient drug substance on hand
